data.name: Muqatil
data.gender_notes: Muqatil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who fights in the way of Allah
data.long_meaning: Muqatil is derived from the root word 'q-t-l' which means to fight or to struggle. It is a name that connotes courage, bravery and determination. The name Muqatil carries the meaning “One who fights in the way of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muqatil usually hope their child will grow to embody one who fights in the way of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To struggle in the way of Allah is not only a physical act but also an inner spiritual battle against one's own ego and desires.
data.etymology: Muqatil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who fights in the way of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muqatil total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: مقاتل

in_hindi.name: मुक़ातिल

Muqatils were early warriors and champions of Islamic cause, who bravely fought battles against various invasions and outside forces to protect and safeguard their communities and religious practices. The name continues to inspire and resonate with those who value courage, strength, and perseverance.

The suffix '-il' in the name signifies 'benefactor of Allah' or 'servant of Allah'. Therefore, a person named Muqatil is encouraged to continually strive towards pleasing and serving Allah through their actions, good intentions, and character. The name fosters an understanding that life is a battleground between right and wrong, and it is the duty of each person to fight their inner and outer battles with courage, determination, and faith.
